formattedAddress: 2211 S Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78704, USA

editorialSummary.text: Boutique dog grooming studio with a calm, cage-free approach and organic products.

text.text: My anxious rescue greyhound actually pulls TOWARD the door now. Quiet, unhurried, no cages. Worth every cent and then some.
Best doodle cut in Austin, hands down. Booking is by text which is a little chaotic — took two days to get a reply — but the result is worth it.
Lovely people, gorgeous results, my corgi came back smelling like lavender. Only wish their website showed prices — had to call to find out.
They send a photo mid-groom so you can approve the length. Small touch, huge trust. Their Instagram is adorable but hasn't posted in months — post more, people need to see this work!
